jobs.title: IT Application Officer
jobs.description: Job Description - Manage and support business applications their lifecycle to ensure system availability, performance, and continuous improvement. - Analyze business requirements and deliver application solutions, enhancements, and system integrations that support business operations. - Provide Level 2 application support by troubleshooting issues, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating with vendors to ensure timely resolution. - Monitor application performance, perform preventive maintenance, and ensure system security, stability, backup, and recovery processes. - Collaborate with business users on requirements gathering, implementation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, and post-implementation support. - Manage user access, maintain application documentation, and ensure compliance with IT policies, standards, and audit requirements. - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve business processes and user experience. Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Accounting Information System, or a related field. - Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Application Support, Business Applications, ERP, or a similar role, including at least two end-to-end ERP or enterprise system implementations. - Strong knowledge of SDLC, SQL, ERP/business applications, and system integration. - Experience in application troubleshooting, UAT, vendor management, and stakeholder collaboration. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. - ITIL Foundation or other relevant certifications are an advantage.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist / Video Content Creator
jobs.description: Content Creator / Social Media Specialist Punya passion di dunia content creation dan selalu update dengan tren Instagram & TikTok? Yuk, bergabung bersama tim kami! Kualifikasi: Pendidikan bebas dari seluruh background pendidikan. Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang social media management (lebih disukai di sektor F&N). Menguasai tools editing foto & video (Canva, CapCut, dll). Memahami strategi iklan digital (Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads). Kreatif, peka tren, dan memiliki kemampuan storytelling. Komunikatif dan mampu bekerja sama dalam tim. Job Desc: Menyusun strategi media sosial sesuai target branding. Membuat dan mengelola content plan bulanan. Produksi konten foto, video, dan copywriting yang sesuai dengan identitas brand. Mengelola kanal Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan platform relevan lainnya. Menganalisis data performa konten (reach, engagement, conversion) dan membuat laporan bulanan. Mengelola iklan berbayar (Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads) untuk meningkatkan jangkauan. Berinteraksi dengan audiens melalui komentar, DM, dan live session. Berkolaborasi dengan FO untuk menjalankan campaign promo atau event. Memastikan setiap konten sejalan dengan company value dan etika layanan kesehatan. KIRIMKAN CV BESERTA PORTFOLIO SOSIAL MEDIA DAN DATA PERFORMA KALIAN.

jobs.description: Company Description Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality. Nestled in the heart of Bali, the world's favorite island destination, Novotel Bali Ubud Resort offers an unparalleled experience combining the rich Balinese cultural and artistic heritage with the natural beauty and tranquility. Job Description This position is responsible for supervising and coordinating the daily operations of the security team to ensure the safety and protection of guests, employees, property, and company assets. This role includes monitoring staff performance, conducting inspections, managing incidents, and maintaining security standards and procedures. Ensure the highest level of safety and security for our Guests, Heartists, Vendors, and Suppliers through an efficient and proactive approach in daily operations. Qualifications Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in a similar capacity Certificates in National Skills Recognition System, CPR, First Aid Management and Basic Fire Fighting Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language Good communication skills Must be able to maintain confidentiality at all times Honest with a high level of integrity Ability to remain calm and react fast to situations Ability to work effectively and contribute in a team Self-motivated and energetic Must be well-presented and professionally groomed at all times Additional Information WHY WORK FOR ACCOR Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at Accor hotels worldwide. Develop your talent through Accor’s learning programs. Opportunity to grow within your property and across the world! Ability to contribute to the community and make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) activities.

jobs.title: Ecommerce Manager
jobs.description: About the job We are looking for a results-oriented E-commerce Manager who can accelerate growth, strengthen platform presence, and deliver outstanding commercial outcomes for our brand portfolio. This is a high-impact position where strategic thinking, analytical excellence, and strong business acumen meet executional leadership. Key Responsibilities: Lead the analysis and optimization of brand assortment, pricing, and promotion strategies to maximize revenue performance. Monitor and interpret key e-commerce metrics across Shopee, TikTok Shop, Tokopedia, and Lazada (GMV, CTR, C_O, GPM, UV, PV, etc.) to identify opportunities and gaps. Drive the execution of platform promotion tools (Flash Sale, Bundles, Vouchers, and other mechanics) to boost conversion and traffic. Manage and optimize marketplace advertising to achieve efficient ROI and campaign scalability. Oversee daily e-commerce operations and ensure seamless execution across channels. Lead campaign submissions and deliver sharp, actionable post-mortem insights to guide future strategy. Build strong internal alignment and maintain strategic relationships with platform partners to unlock growth levers and exclusive opportunities. Requierements: Bachelor’s degree or higher in any field. 3–5 years of proven experience in big brands, e-commerce enablers, or marketplace platforms. Strong commercial awareness with excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Highly analytical with strong numerical capabilities and a data-driven mindset. Experience handling established or fast-growing brands is a strong advantage. Fast learner, adaptable, and able to thrive in a high-pace commercial environment. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for analysis and business reporting.

jobs.title: Marketing & Event Executive
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Marketing & Event Executive yang berpengalaman dan dinamis untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Tangerang, Banten. Sebagai Marketing & Event Executive, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam merencanakan, mengorganisir, dan melaksanakan acara pemasaran yang inovatif dan berdampak. Posisi ini membutuhkan profesional yang kreatif, terorganisir, dan memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang pemasaran modern serta manajemen acara. Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk menciptakan pengalaman acara yang berkesan, mengkoordinasikan berbagai stakeholder, dan memastikan setiap detail berjalan sempurna untuk mendukung tujuan pemasaran perusahaan kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Merencanakan dan mengembangkan strategi acara yang selaras dengan tujuan pemasaran dan brand awareness perusahaan. Mengelola seluruh aspek operasional acara, mulai dari konsep, persiapan, hingga eksekusi dan evaluasi pasca-acara. Berkoordinasi dengan vendor, supplier, dan pihak ketiga lainnya untuk memastikan kualitas layanan dan pemenuhan anggaran acara. Mengembangkan konten dan materi pemasaran yang menarik untuk mempromosikan acara kepada target audiens. Mengelola registrasi peserta, konfirmasi kehadiran, dan komunikasi dengan attendee sebelum, selama, dan setelah acara. Memastikan pengalaman peserta yang luar biasa melalui manajemen venue, catering, audiovisual, dan elemen acara lainnya. Menganalisis efektivitas acara dan menyiapkan laporan evaluasi dengan metrik kinerja yang terukur. jobs.title: Fisioterapis
jobs.description: About the role Kami sedang mencari Fisioterapis yang berdedikasi dan berorientasi pada pasien untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Kota Bogor. Kandidat akan memberikan layanan fisioterapi profesional dengan fokus utama pada assessment, treatment, rehabilitation, dan edukasi pasien, khususnya pada kasus musculoskeletal. Key responsibilities Melakukan assessment dan evaluasi kondisi pasien sesuai kompetensi fisioterapi. Menyusun dan memberikan program treatment serta rehabilitasi yang sesuai kebutuhan pasien. Memberikan terapi dan exercise program secara aman dan profesional. Memberikan edukasi kepada pasien mengenai latihan, pemulihan, dan pencegahan keluhan/cedera. Mencatat perkembangan dan hasil terapi pasien secara akurat. Berkolaborasi dengan tim klinis dan profesional kesehatan lainnya. Menjaga standar pelayanan dan keselamatan pasien. Requirments Minimal lulusan D4 Fisioterapi. Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memiliki STR aktif; STR yang masih dalam proses dipersilakan. Memiliki etos kerja tinggi dan patient-oriented. Memiliki ketertarikan dan passion di bidang Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy. Mampu bekerja secara profesional dan kolaboratif. Pengalaman atau hobi olahraga menjadi nilai tambah. Benefits Gaji kompetitif + insentif. Akomodasi untuk kandidat dari luar daerah. Pelatihan dan pengembangan keterampilan fisioterapi secara berkala oleh tim profesional.

About the role

Kala Group is seeking an experienced and dynamic Restaurant Supervisor to join our team in Badung, Bali. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in delivering exceptional dining experiences to our guests. As Restaurant Supervisor, you will be at the heart of our operations, ensuring seamless service delivery, maintaining high standards of hospitality, and leading our front-of-house team. This position is integral to upholding Kala Group's reputation for excellence and creating memorable experiences for every guest who walks through our doors.

What you'll be doing

  • Supervising and coordinating the daily operations of the restaurant floor, ensuring efficient service delivery throughout all service periods

  • Managing and motivating the front-of-house team, including hosts, servers, and support staff, whilst maintaining professional standards and positive team dynamics

  • Training and developing staff members to ensure they deliver consistent, high-quality service in line with company standards and procedures

  • Monitoring table management, guest seating arrangements, and service pacing to optimise guest satisfaction and operational efficiency

  • Handling guest inquiries, complaints, and special requests with professionalism and diplomacy, resolving issues promptly to ensure positive outcomes

  • Maintaining cleanliness and organisation of the dining area, bar, and related service spaces throughout service

  • Assisting with inventory management, stock rotation, and reporting on restaurant supplies and equipment needs

  • Collaborating with the kitchen team and management to coordinate special events, private functions, and themed dining experiences

  • Implementing and adhering to health, safety, and hygiene regulations to create a secure environment for guests and staff

  • Reporting to management on daily operations, guest feedback, and identifying opportunities for service improvement


What we're looking for

  • Proven experience as a Restaurant Supervisor or similar supervisory role within the hospitality and tourism industry, preferably in a fine dining or upscale casual setting

  • Strong leadership and team management abilities, with the capacity to inspire, motivate, and develop staff members

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with guests and team members at all levels

  • Comprehensive knowledge of restaurant operations, service standards, and hospitality best practices

  • Outstanding customer service orientation with the ability to anticipate guest needs and exceed expectations

  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to handle challenging situations calmly and professionally

  • Proficiency in restaurant management systems and point-of-sale (POS) technology

  • Knowledge of food and beverage offerings, wine pairings, and menu details to assist guests and staff

  • Fluency in English; additional languages (particularly Indonesian or Mandarin) are advantageous

  • Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required by the business

  • Certification in food safety or hospitality management is preferred


What we offer

At Kala Group, we are committed to creating a supportive and rewarding work environment for our team members. We believe that our staff are our greatest asset, and we invest in their professional development and wellbeing. We offer competitive remuneration packages, opportunities for career advancement within our growing organisation, and a positive workplace culture that values teamwork, creativity, and excellence. We provide ongoing training and development programmes to help you enhance your skills and progress in your career. Our team benefits from a dynamic work environment where you will work alongside passionate hospitality professionals and gain experience in a thriving tourism destination.

About us

Kala Group is a leading hospitality and tourism operator in Bali, committed to delivering exceptional experiences across our portfolio of restaurants and venues. With a focus on quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, we have established ourselves as a respected name in the industry. Our mission is to create unique and memorable dining experiences that reflect the vibrant culture and warmth of Bali whilst maintaining the highest standards of service and professionalism. We pride ourselves on our diverse team, our commitment to sustainability, and our dedication to supporting the local community. At Kala Group, we believe that success comes from fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Apply now

If you are an experienced Restaurant Supervisor with a passion for hospitality and a commitment to excellence, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter, and references to join our dynamic team at Kala Group in Badung, Bali.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist
jobs.description: Kami membutuhkan seorang Supply Chain Specialist untuk bergabung dengan PT Matsya Qualitas Indonesia. Sebagai Supply Chain Specialist, anda akan bertanggung jawab menjaga supply chain dan operasional logistik perusahaan di Jakarta, serta bekerja sama dengan departemen lainnya dalam menunjang proses produksi, distribusi, dan keuangan perusahaan, Tanggung Jawab: Procurement Support : Bekerjasama dengan tim pengadaan untuk memastikan pengadaan barang yang berkaitan dengan operasional perusahaan. Pengadaan dan rantai suplai meliputi pencarian supplier barang, negosiasi harga, dan memelihara komunikasi yang baik dengan supplier. Koordinasi secara intens dan kontinu dengan tim produksi untuk memastikan kebutuhan produksi terpenuhi secara tepat waktu. Logistics Management : Mengelola dan mengawasi proses logistik barang antara Pulau Seribu dan Jakarta Utara secara efisien. Hal ini meliputi perencanaan dan eksekusi moda transportasi dalam memastikan kebutuhan logistic terpenuhi secara optimal dan efisien. Melakukan pencatatan system logistic dan rantai suplai Post-harvest Handling : Melakukan handling dan packing (pengemasan) hasil panen ikan di pelabuhan dan area pemrosesan, memastikan semua pesanan sesuai dengan standar perusahaan ( quality control ) dan terkirim sesuai dengan pesanan customer berdasarkan pesanan mereka. Customer Delivery : Melakukan koordinasi proses pengiriman produk ke tujuan sesuai alamat customer. Merencanakan dan mengoptimalkan rute pengiriman bagi para kurir dan memastikan ketepatan waktu pengiriman dan kepuasan pelanggan. Documentation and Record-Keeping : Melakukan dokumentasi proses handling dan packing, mengelola dokumentasi proses penjualan dan pengiriman. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan: Sarjana diberbagai bidang. Sarjana bidang Perikanan lebih diutamakan. Pengalaman Kerja : Memiliki pengalaman 0 - 2 tahun dibidang Operasional, Manajemen Supply Chain, atau bidang terkait lainnya. Kemampuan Komunikasi : Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tertulis yang baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia, kemampuan dasar berbicara/menulis dalam Bahasa Inggris, dapat menyampaikan informasi dengan jelas secara profesional ke berbagai pihak berbeda. Kemampuan Beradaptasi dan Fleksibilitas: Mampu beradaptasi dengan cepat terhadap lingkungan baru dan menantang. Mampu melakukan beberapa tugas bersamaan dan menyesuaikan prioritas yang berubah. Siap untuk menangani situasi yang tidak terduga. Kemampuan dan Keinginan untuk Belajar : Memiliki raisa keinginan belajar yang tinggi untuk mendapatkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan baru. Bersedia untuk terlibat dalam pelatihan dan pengembangan dalam meningkatkan kinerja pekerjaan. Penggunaan Perangkat Lunak: mahir dalam menggunakan Microsoft Word dan Microsoft Excel. Kemampuan Berkendara (tidak wajib, poin tambahan): mampu menyetir mobil dan motor serta kepemilikan SIM A & C menjadi poin plus.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description: Business Development Manager (BD) Business Unit: Embodied AI Data Collection Location: South Jakarta (Jakarta Selatan), Indonesia Work Arrangement: On-site / Frequent site visits required Employment Type: Full-time Salary: IDR 8,000,000–15,000,000/month + performance bonus About the Role We are looking for a Business Development Manager to support the growth of our Embodied AI Data Collection business. You will be responsible for developing, onboarding, and managing data collection sites across manufacturing, warehousing & logistics, retail, and other commercial environments. You will manage the full site lifecycle, from identifying potential locations and negotiating partnerships to site activation, ongoing collection, utilization, and settlement. This role requires strong B2B business development capabilities, an established network, excellent negotiation skills, and a willingness to conduct frequent on-site visits. Key Responsibilities: Site Development & Acquisition Identify and acquire suitable data collection sites across manufacturing, industrial, warehousing, logistics, retail, and commercial environments. Build relationships with site owners, business owners, operations leads, and other key decision-makers. Conduct site scouting and initial evaluation, including business authenticity, operational scenarios, collectible areas, accessibility, safety, confidentiality, cost, and partnership sustainability. Lead commercial negotiations and drive partnerships from initial contact through agreement and activation. Site Lifecycle Management Manage the full site lifecycle from lead generation, evaluation, NDA/terms negotiation, and activation through repeat collection and settlement. Maintain accurate records of site resources, partnership status, utilization, and operational information. Coordinate with the data collection and operations teams regarding schedules, site access, operational issues, and settlement. Monitor site utilization, valid collection hours, and potential for repeated data collection. Part-Time BD Network Recruit, screen, train, and manage part-time Business Development personnel. Establish targets and processes for lead generation, site screening, partnership progression, handover, and incentive settlement. Develop a scalable and regionally distributed BD network. Monitor BD performance and maintain digital reporting and tracking. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Data Collection, Operations, Finance, and Management teams to improve site onboarding and operational processes. Report regularly on site development progress, pipeline, conversion rates, utilization, risks, and partnership performance. Identify operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution. Requirements Bachelor's degree or above. Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Management-related majors are preferred. 3–5+ years of experience in B2B Business Development, Sales, Key Account Management, Channel Development, or Operations Management in Indonesia. Proven experience acquiring enterprise clients or developing complex partnerships from 0 to 1 . Strong negotiation, relationship management, and business development skills. Established or demonstrable network within manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, retail, industrial parks, or enterprise services. Ability to engage decision-makers such as factory owners, plant managers, warehouse managers, logistics operators, and retail managers. Strong organizational, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills. Comfortable managing multiple sites and partnerships simultaneously. Willing to conduct frequent site visits and occasional weekend/night coordination. Professional working proficiency in English or Chinese , including business communication and written reporting. Preferred Qualifications Experience in SaaS, technology, logistics platforms, enterprise services, supply chain, outsourced operations, or project-based delivery. Experience managing part-time sales/BD staff, channel partners, or regional agent networks. Experience in site/venue leasing or enterprise partnership development. Established relationships within manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, industrial parks, retail chains, or enterprise services. Previous exposure to AI, robotics, embodied AI, data collection, or emerging technology . Compensation & Growth IDR 8,000,000–15,000,000/month , depending on experience and capability. Performance bonus tied to site activation and valid collection hours . Opportunity to be part of the core build-out of an Embodied AI Data Collection business . Business Development Manager (BD)

Business Unit: Embodied AI Data Collection
Location: South Jakarta (Jakarta Selatan), Indonesia
Work Arrangement: On-site / Frequent site visits required
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: IDR 8,000,000–15,000,000/month + performance bonus

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to support the growth of our Embodied AI Data Collection business.

You will be responsible for developing, onboarding, and managing data collection sites across manufacturing, warehousing & logistics, retail, and other commercial environments. You will manage the full site lifecycle, from identifying potential locations and negotiating partnerships to site activation, ongoing collection, utilization, and settlement.

This role requires strong B2B business development capabilities, an established network, excellent negotiation skills, and a willingness to conduct frequent on-site visits.

Key Responsibilities:

Site Development & Acquisition

  • Identify and acquire suitable data collection sites across manufacturing, industrial, warehousing, logistics, retail, and commercial environments.

  • Build relationships with site owners, business owners, operations leads, and other key decision-makers.

  • Conduct site scouting and initial evaluation, including business authenticity, operational scenarios, collectible areas, accessibility, safety, confidentiality, cost, and partnership sustainability.

  • Lead commercial negotiations and drive partnerships from initial contact through agreement and activation.

Site Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the full site lifecycle from lead generation, evaluation, NDA/terms negotiation, and activation through repeat collection and settlement.

  • Maintain accurate records of site resources, partnership status, utilization, and operational information.

  • Coordinate with the data collection and operations teams regarding schedules, site access, operational issues, and settlement.

  • Monitor site utilization, valid collection hours, and potential for repeated data collection.

Part-Time BD Network

  • Recruit, screen, train, and manage part-time Business Development personnel.

  • Establish targets and processes for lead generation, site screening, partnership progression, handover, and incentive settlement.

  • Develop a scalable and regionally distributed BD network.

  • Monitor BD performance and maintain digital reporting and tracking.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Data Collection, Operations, Finance, and Management teams to improve site onboarding and operational processes.

  • Report regularly on site development progress, pipeline, conversion rates, utilization, risks, and partnership performance.

  • Identify operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above. Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Management-related majors are preferred.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in B2B Business Development, Sales, Key Account Management, Channel Development, or Operations Management in Indonesia.

  • Proven experience acquiring enterprise clients or developing complex partnerships from 0 to 1.

  • Strong negotiation, relationship management, and business development skills.

  • Established or demonstrable network within manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, retail, industrial parks, or enterprise services.

  • Ability to engage decision-makers such as factory owners, plant managers, warehouse managers, logistics operators, and retail managers.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills.

  • Comfortable managing multiple sites and partnerships simultaneously.

  • Willing to conduct frequent site visits and occasional weekend/night coordination.

  • Professional working proficiency in English or Chinese, including business communication and written reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in SaaS, technology, logistics platforms, enterprise services, supply chain, outsourced operations, or project-based delivery.

  • Experience managing part-time sales/BD staff, channel partners, or regional agent networks.

  • Experience in site/venue leasing or enterprise partnership development.

  • Established relationships within manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, industrial parks, retail chains, or enterprise services.

  • Previous exposure to AI, robotics, embodied AI, data collection, or emerging technology.

Compensation & Growth

  • IDR 8,000,000–15,000,000/month, depending on experience and capability.

  • Performance bonus tied to site activation and valid collection hours.

  • Opportunity to be part of the core build-out of an Embodied AI Data Collection business.

  • Potential to take on broader responsibilities in regional site-network development and BD team management.

Good understanding and knowledge of Indonesian taxation and its application in accounting processes. Strong skills in financial data processing and analysis. Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel. Detail-oriented, accurate, responsible, and highly organized. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Able to work independently and effectively as part of a team. Full WFO at SCBD, South Jakarta.

  1. Record daily financial transactions accurately in the accounting system.

  2. Prepare journal entries and assist with the month-end closing process.

  3. Manage Accounts Payable, including invoice verification and payment processing.

  4. Perform bank reconciliations and maintain accurate cash records.

  5. Manage petty cash, including disbursements, reimbursements, and reconciliations.

  6. Maintain accounting documents and ensure proper filing of financial records.

  7. Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and supporting schedules.

  8. Support basic tax administration, including preparing documentation for VAT and withholding tax filings.

  9. Maintain fixed asset records and depreciation schedules.

  10. Use accounting software for daily bookkeeping; Xero experience is preferred.

  11. Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  2. Critical person, decisive and METICULOUS

  3. Minimum 2 years of accounting experience.

  4. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting software; Xero experience is preferred.

  5. Basic understanding of Indonesian tax regulations.

  6. Detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to work independently.

  7. Good communication and teamwork skills.

  8. Own a motorcycle and be willing to use it for work-related mobility.


What We’re Looking For

Someone who is accurate, responsible, analytical, and proactive, with a strong understanding of daily accounting operations and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Interested? Send us your latest CV/resume and tell us why you are the right candidate for this position.

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description: LOWONGAN KERJA — OPERATIONS LEAD Ikut Membangun Sistem Koperasi Syariah dari Dekat Koperasi Syirkah Berkah Bersama (KSBB) adalah koperasi syariah digital nasional berbasis di Sidoarjo yang sedang membangun ekosistem syirkah bagi UMKM Indonesia. Saat ini KSBB memiliki 1500+ anggota. KSBB sedang berada di fase pertumbuhan — banyak sistem masih dirancang, diuji, dan diperbaiki dari nol. Kami mencari calon Operations Lead yang siap ikut membangun sistem itu, bukan sekadar menjalankannya. YANG AKAN ANDA KERJAKAN 1. Merancang dan menyempurnakan sistem operasional bersama manajemen dan direksi 2. Memimpin dan membina tim untuk mencapai target bersama 3. Memonitor dan mengevaluasi target serta kinerja tim 4. Mengidentifikasi masalah dan merumuskan solusi yang bisa langsung diterapkan KENAPA KSBB? Kami mencari orang yang ingin belajar membangun, bukan sekadar mengisi posisi. Anda akan berhadapan dengan masalah nyata, diberi ruang mengusulkan perbaikan, dan melihat langsung dampak dari keputusan yang Anda ambil — pengalaman berharga jika suatu hari Anda ingin merintis usaha sendiri. YANG KAMI CARI Kami lebih melihat cara berpikir dan kemauan belajar daripada panjangnya CV. 1. Mahasiswa semester akhir atau alumni S1 2. Mampu memimpin dan menggerakkan orang (tidak harus pernah jadi supervisor) 3. Senang memecahkan masalah dan terbiasa bekerja dengan target 4. Komunikatif, proaktif, cepat belajar 5. Tertarik pada bisnis, entrepreneurship, dan pengembangan organisasi 6. Nilai tambah: pengalaman memimpin organisasi, kepanitiaan, komunitas, atau proyek YANG ANDA DAPATKAN 1. Gaji UMK + bonus kinerja 2. Mentorship langsung dari Direksi KSBB 3. Pengalaman lintas aspek operasional dan manajemen 4. Ruang mengembangkan leadership, problem solving, dan business acumen 5. Lingkungan kerja profesional 6. Kajian rutin 2× per pekan Pepelegi, Sidoarjo — Work From Office APAKAH INI UNTUK ANDA? Jika Anda mencari pekerjaan yang sekadar memberi gaji bulanan, mungkin ini bukan tempat yang tepat. Tapi jika Anda ingin membangun organisasi, memimpin orang, dan mempersiapkan diri jadi entrepreneur — kami ingin mengenal Anda. Submit ke ksbb.co.id/karir Melamar posisi : OPERATIONS LEAD. Deadline: 1 September 2026

jobs.title: Barista
jobs.description: Barista – Nara Kupu Village (Sawangan, Depok) Nara Kupu Village (Sawangan, Depok) adalah destinasi eco-wisata terpadu yang menggabungkan restoran sehat, kebun organik, edukasi pertanian, dan interaksi dengan hewan, ideal untuk keluarga yang ingin menikmati udara segar dan suasana hijau. Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Menyiapkan dan menyajikan kopi serta minuman non-kopi sesuai standar perusahaan. Mengembangkan dan menciptakan menu minuman baru sesuai konsep perusahaan. Mengoperasikan dan merawat mesin kopi serta peralatan pendukung. Menjaga kualitas rasa, tampilan, dan konsistensi setiap minuman. Memberikan pelayanan yang ramah, cepat, dan profesional kepada pelanggan. Menjaga kebersihan area kerja, peralatan, dan bahan baku sesuai standar higiene. Mengelola stok bahan baku serta mendukung kelancaran operasional perusahaan. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK. Berpengalaman sebagai Barista minimal 2–3 tahun. Memahami dasar pembuatan kopi, & minuman non-kopi. Mampu membuat latte art. Berpenampilan rapi, bersih, dan memiliki sikap kerja yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Siap bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur. Diutamakan berdomisili di Depok dan sekitarnya.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Butter Protein Club - Pererenan
jobs.description: Position : Head of Procurement Client : Butter Protein Club Location : Bali, Indonesia Department : Procurement Reports To : General Manager About Us The Cakap Group (TCG) is a licensed hospitality management and restaurant consulting company in Indonesia with an 11-year history of success. We design, launch, and manage a diverse portfolio of prestigious projects, ranging from boutique hotels and luxury resorts to restaurants and luxury yachts. With over 150 successful projects and 800+ employees recruited, we offer a stable, dynamic, and internationally standardized working environment. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of specialists, supported by our state-of-the-art Research & Development (R&D) kitchen and modern training facilities in Bali. Join us to accelerate your career and be part of an exceptional team that transforms ambitious visions into world-class hospitality experiences. About Our Client Butter Protein Club is a biohacker-inspired fitness nutrition hub in Pererenan, Bali, driven by the ethos: "Built for performance. Powered by beef." The brand focuses on 100% seed-oil-free, animal-based, customizable protein bowls with exact calorie counts, serving a growing community of fitness enthusiasts in a vibrant, dog-friendly environment. As the business continues to grow, maintaining consistent ingredient quality, reliable supply, competitive purchasing costs, and strict adherence to product standards is essential. We are seeking a commercially minded and detail-oriented procurement professional who can build strong supplier relationships while ensuring the business receives the right products at the right quality, price, and time. What You Will Contribute As the Head of Procurement at Butter Protein Club, you will be responsible for overseeing and developing the overall procurement function of the business. Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams, you will ensure the business has a reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality supply chain that supports daily operations and future growth. You will take ownership of supplier sourcing, purchasing, negotiations, inventory coordination, cost control, and procurement standards. A key part of your role will be ensuring that all ingredients and products comply with Butter Protein Club's strict product philosophy, including its 100% seed-oil-free and animal-based concept. Your commercial judgment, supplier network, negotiation skills, and attention to detail will directly contribute to product consistency, operational efficiency, and overall profitability. What You Will Do Lead and manage the overall procurement function for Butter Protein Club. Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business requirements, product standards, and financial objectives. Source, evaluate, and establish relationships with reliable local and international suppliers where appropriate. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, lead times, and other commercial terms with suppliers. Ensure all purchased ingredients, products, and supplies meet the required quality, specifications, and brand standards. Ensure strict compliance with the company's 100% seed-oil-free and animal-based ingredient requirements. Work closely with the General Manager, Head Chef, and operational teams to understand purchasing requirements and forecast demand. Monitor purchasing activities to ensure the right quantity and quality of products are available at the right time. Develop and maintain an approved supplier list and regularly assess supplier performance. Conduct regular price comparisons and market checks to ensure competitive purchasing costs. Monitor food and beverage purchasing costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality. Manage purchase orders, supplier quotations, invoices, and other procurement documentation accurately. Coordinate with the kitchen and operations teams regarding stock requirements, product specifications, and delivery schedules. Monitor supplier delivery performance, product availability, quality, and consistency. Handle supplier issues, discrepancies, rejected products, shortages, and delayed deliveries promptly. Work closely with inventory and operations teams to minimize overstocking, stock-outs, spoilage, and unnecessary wastage. Support accurate inventory control through regular stock checks, reconciliation, and procurement planning. Maintain accurate procurement records, pricing databases, supplier information, and purchasing reports. Monitor market trends, commodity pricing, and availability of key ingredients to support effective purchasing decisions. Identify alternative suppliers and products to minimize supply-chain risks and maintain business continuity. Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, food safety requirements, and applicable Indonesian regulations. Support the development of procurement SOPs, purchasing procedures, and supplier evaluation systems. Prepare regular procurement reports and provide recommendations to the General Manager regarding cost, supplier performance, and purchasing strategy. Continuously identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, product quality, supplier performance, and overall profitability. Who We're Looking For Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or sourcing within the hospitality, restaurant, F&B, or food-related industry. Previous experience in a Procurement Manager, Purchasing Manager, Head of Procurement, or similar leadership role is highly preferred. Strong understanding of F&B procurement, including fresh produce, meat, dairy, dry goods, beverages, and other restaurant supplies. Strong knowledge of local supplier networks and the Bali F&B supply market. Proven experience in supplier sourcing, evaluation, negotiation, and relationship management. Strong commercial and negotiation skills with a proven ability to achieve competitive purchasing costs. Good understanding of food costs, COGS, inventory management, stock control, and purchasing budgets. Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and administrative skills. Ability to evaluate product quality, specifications, pricing, and supplier reliability. Experience developing and maintaining supplier databases, purchasing records, and procurement reports. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond quickly to supply and operational challenges. Proactive and commercially minded, with the ability to identify cost-saving and efficiency opportunities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and internal teams. Comfortable working in a fast-paced restaurant environment where product availability and consistency are critical. Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken. High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism when managing suppliers and company purchasing activities. What We Offer Competitive salary (negotiable based on qualifications) Religious Holiday Allowance (THR) BPJS Health & Employment Coverage Meal Allowance Service Charge Career growth opportunities within a growing hospitality and F&B business

jobs.title: Senior Staff Tax and Accounting Specialist
jobs.description: About the role We are seeking a Senior Accounting, Finance, and Tax specialist to join CV. Harum Indah Sejahtera on a contract basis. This is a critical position based in Tangerang Regency, where you will take on a strategyc role responsible for overseeing accounting operations, financial reporting, and tax compliance. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the organization maintains robust financial control, accurate financial statements, and full regulatory compliance with Indonesian tax regulations and accounting standards. This position reports to board of directors and directly impact the financial integrity and strategic decision making of the company. Job Resposibilities Finance & Accounting Handle Daily Accounting transaction and maintain accurate financial records using Accurate System. Prepare Journal Entries, General Ledger (GL), trial balance, and supporting schedules. Manage Account Payable (AP), and Account Receivable (AR) Examine petty cash reports and take responsibility for those reports Perform bank reconciliation and cash flow monitoring. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Support month-end and year -end closing process. Maintain fixed asset records and depreciation schedules. Ensure proper documentation and filling of accounting records. Support budgeting, financial analysis, and management reporting. Tax Calculate, prepare, and submit monthly annual tax reports. Handle PPh21, PPh23, PPh26, PPh4 (2), PPn, and Corporate Income Tax. Prepare tax reconciliations. Issues tax invoices (e-Faktur) and withholding tax certificates (e-Bupot). Operate Coretax and other Indonesian tax systems. Ensure compliance with Indonesian tax regulation. Handle SP2DK and respond to questions from the Directorate of Taxation. jobs.title: APOTEKER / PENANGGUNG JAWAB TEKNIS (PJT) PKRT
jobs.description: Kami adalah perusahaan manufaktur Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang fragrance dan home fragrance , dengan produk seperti scented candle, reed diffuser, room spray, dan berbagai produk fragrance lainnya. Seiring dengan perkembangan bisnis dan peningkatan kapasitas produksi, kami sedang mencari Apoteker / Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) PKRT yang bertanggung jawab, teliti, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Posisi ini merupakan peran yang cukup luas, tidak hanya berfokus pada aspek regulasi, tetapi juga akan terlibat langsung dalam produksi, quality control, inventory/stock management, reporting, dan administrasi operasional . Kami mencari seseorang yang dapat menjadi bagian penting dalam membangun sistem produksi dan dokumentasi perusahaan yang rapi, konsisten, dan sesuai dengan standar yang berlaku. Tanggung Jawab Regulasi & PJT PKRT Bertindak sebagai Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) PKRT perusahaan. Memastikan kegiatan produksi dan dokumentasi memenuhi ketentuan PKRT dan CPPKRTB yang berlaku. Mengelola dan menjaga kelengkapan dokumen terkait regulasi dan perizinan. Membantu proses pendaftaran, perizinan, dan pengurusan dokumen PKRT. Menyiapkan dan menjaga dokumen yang diperlukan untuk audit atau inspeksi. Membuat, memperbarui, dan memastikan penerapan SOP terkait produksi dan quality control. Memastikan dokumentasi produksi dan quality control dilakukan secara konsisten. Produksi & Quality Control Memantau kegiatan produksi sehari-hari. Memastikan proses produksi berjalan sesuai SOP, formula, dan spesifikasi yang telah ditetapkan. Melakukan review terhadap production report dan batch documentation. Memantau kualitas bahan baku dan produk jadi. Membantu proses testing dan stability testing produk. Mengidentifikasi dan membantu menyelesaikan masalah kualitas atau penyimpangan produksi. Berkoordinasi dengan tim produksi untuk menjaga konsistensi kualitas produk. Stock & Inventory Mengelola pencatatan stok bahan baku, packaging, dan produk jadi. Melakukan stock opname dan stock reconciliation secara berkala. Memantau penggunaan bahan baku dan packaging. Memastikan pencatatan batch, tanggal produksi, dan expiry date dilakukan dengan baik apabila diperlukan. Memastikan bahan baku dan produk disimpan dengan baik sesuai kebutuhan. Reporting & Administrasi Membuat daily/weekly/monthly production report . Membuat dan menjaga laporan stok. Mengelola dokumen produksi, QC, dan regulasi. Memastikan seluruh dokumentasi tersusun secara rapi dan mudah ditelusuri. Membantu pekerjaan administrasi operasional lainnya yang berkaitan dengan produksi dan regulasi. Membantu management dalam penyusunan laporan dan dokumentasi perusahaan. Kualifikasi Wajib Lulusan dan memiliki profesi Apoteker . Memiliki izin/registrasi Apoteker yang masih aktif dan valid . Izin/registrasi Apoteker tidak sedang digunakan, terdaftar, atau terikat sebagai penanggung jawab pada perusahaan lain . Memiliki sertifikasi PJT PKRT . Memiliki sertifikat pelatihan CPPKRTB yang masih berlaku/diakui . Bersedia menjadi PJT PKRT perusahaan secara full-time . Bersedia bekerja full-time dan on-site di Jakarta . Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi yang baik. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri. Kualifikasi yang Diutamakan Memiliki pengalaman sebelumnya sebagai PJT PKRT . Memiliki pengalaman dalam proses CPPKRTB dan regulasi PKRT. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang manufaktur, production, quality control, atau regulatory affairs. Memiliki pengalaman di industri fragrance, home fragrance, kosmetik, household products , atau industri terkait menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami prinsip GMP dan quality management. Terbiasa menggunakan Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets . Mampu membuat laporan dan mengelola dokumentasi secara sistematis. Kami Mencari Kandidat yang... Teliti dan sangat memperhatikan detail. Bertanggung jawab dan dapat dipercaya. Terorganisir dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik. Tidak hanya menunggu instruksi, tetapi mampu melihat masalah dan mencari solusi. Kami adalah perusahaan manufaktur Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang fragrance dan home fragrance, dengan produk seperti scented candle, reed diffuser, room spray, dan berbagai produk fragrance lainnya.

Seiring dengan perkembangan bisnis dan peningkatan kapasitas produksi, kami sedang mencari Apoteker / Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) PKRT yang bertanggung jawab, teliti, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami.

Posisi ini merupakan peran yang cukup luas, tidak hanya berfokus pada aspek regulasi, tetapi juga akan terlibat langsung dalam produksi, quality control, inventory/stock management, reporting, dan administrasi operasional.

Kami mencari seseorang yang dapat menjadi bagian penting dalam membangun sistem produksi dan dokumentasi perusahaan yang rapi, konsisten, dan sesuai dengan standar yang berlaku.

Tanggung Jawab

Regulasi & PJT PKRT

  • Bertindak sebagai Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) PKRT perusahaan.

  • Memastikan kegiatan produksi dan dokumentasi memenuhi ketentuan PKRT dan CPPKRTB yang berlaku.

  • Mengelola dan menjaga kelengkapan dokumen terkait regulasi dan perizinan.

  • Membantu proses pendaftaran, perizinan, dan pengurusan dokumen PKRT.

  • Menyiapkan dan menjaga dokumen yang diperlukan untuk audit atau inspeksi.

  • Membuat, memperbarui, dan memastikan penerapan SOP terkait produksi dan quality control.

  • Memastikan dokumentasi produksi dan quality control dilakukan secara konsisten.

Produksi & Quality Control

  • Memantau kegiatan produksi sehari-hari.

  • Memastikan proses produksi berjalan sesuai SOP, formula, dan spesifikasi yang telah ditetapkan.

  • Melakukan review terhadap production report dan batch documentation.

  • Memantau kualitas bahan baku dan produk jadi.

  • Membantu proses testing dan stability testing produk.

  • Mengidentifikasi dan membantu menyelesaikan masalah kualitas atau penyimpangan produksi.

  • Berkoordinasi dengan tim produksi untuk menjaga konsistensi kualitas produk.

Stock & Inventory

  • Mengelola pencatatan stok bahan baku, packaging, dan produk jadi.

  • Melakukan stock opname dan stock reconciliation secara berkala.

  • Memantau penggunaan bahan baku dan packaging.

  • Memastikan pencatatan batch, tanggal produksi, dan expiry date dilakukan dengan baik apabila diperlukan.

  • Memastikan bahan baku dan produk disimpan dengan baik sesuai kebutuhan.

Reporting & Administrasi

  • Membuat daily/weekly/monthly production report.

  • Membuat dan menjaga laporan stok.

  • Mengelola dokumen produksi, QC, dan regulasi.

  • Memastikan seluruh dokumentasi tersusun secara rapi dan mudah ditelusuri.

  • Membantu pekerjaan administrasi operasional lainnya yang berkaitan dengan produksi dan regulasi.

  • Membantu management dalam penyusunan laporan dan dokumentasi perusahaan.

Kualifikasi Wajib

  • Lulusan dan memiliki profesi Apoteker.

  • Memiliki izin/registrasi Apoteker yang masih aktif dan valid.

  • Izin/registrasi Apoteker tidak sedang digunakan, terdaftar, atau terikat sebagai penanggung jawab pada perusahaan lain.

  • Memiliki sertifikasi PJT PKRT.

  • Memiliki sertifikat pelatihan CPPKRTB yang masih berlaku/diakui.

  • Bersedia menjadi PJT PKRT perusahaan secara full-time.

  • Bersedia bekerja full-time dan on-site di Jakarta.

  • Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi yang baik.

  • Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri.

Kualifikasi yang Diutamakan

  • Memiliki pengalaman sebelumnya sebagai PJT PKRT.

  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam proses CPPKRTB dan regulasi PKRT.

  • Memiliki pengalaman di bidang manufaktur, production, quality control, atau regulatory affairs.

  • Memiliki pengalaman di industri fragrance, home fragrance, kosmetik, household products, atau industri terkait menjadi nilai tambah.

  • Memahami prinsip GMP dan quality management.

  • Terbiasa menggunakan Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.

  • Mampu membuat laporan dan mengelola dokumentasi secara sistematis.

Kami Mencari Kandidat yang...

  • Teliti dan sangat memperhatikan detail.

  • Bertanggung jawab dan dapat dipercaya.

  • Terorganisir dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik.

  • Tidak hanya menunggu instruksi, tetapi mampu melihat masalah dan mencari solusi.

  • Nyaman bekerja dalam lingkungan perusahaan yang sedang berkembang.

  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri sekaligus berkoordinasi dengan tim produksi.

  • Memiliki mindset problem-solving dan continuous improvement.

Yang Kami Tawarkan

  • Posisi full-time dengan peran penting dalam perusahaan yang sedang berkembang.

  • Kesempatan untuk terlibat langsung dalam manufacturing, product development, regulatory, dan quality control.

  • Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan entrepreneurial.

  • Kesempatan untuk berkembang bersama perusahaan seiring dengan ekspansi bisnis.

Cara Melamar

Mohon kirimkan:

  1. CV terbaru.

  2. Bukti ijazah/profesi Apoteker.

  3. Bukti izin/registrasi Apoteker yang masih aktif.

  4. Sertifikat PJT PKRT.

  5. Sertifikat pelatihan CPPKRTB.

  6. Dokumen pendukung atau referensi kerja jika tersedia.

PENTING: Kandidat wajib memiliki izin/registrasi Apoteker yang aktif dan tidak sedang digunakan atau terdaftar pada perusahaan lain, serta bersedia menjadi PJT PKRT perusahaan secara full-time.

Opportunity to work directly on production AI systems . Opportunity to build AI agents that perform real-world tasks rather than simple chatbot or prompt-based applications. A highly technical environment focused on shipping meaningful products and measurable output.

We are building a digital employee team for North American real estate agents.

Our AI-powered digital employees operate through WhatsApp and are designed to perform real operational tasks, including tracking transaction deadlines, managing follow-ups, drafting property listings and social media content, and supporting administrative workflows.

We are looking for a Full-Stack AI Engineer with a strong backend focus to help design and develop the infrastructure powering these AI employees.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary of IDR 14,000,000–20,000,000/month, depending on experience and technical capability.

  • Opportunity to build AI agents that perform real-world tasks rather than simple chatbot or prompt-based applications.

jobs.title: HR Supervisor
jobs.description: Ringkasan Kerja: HR Supervisor bertanggungjawab untuk mengelola berbagai fungsi sumber daya manusia, termasuk rekrutmen, pengembangan karyawan, manajemen kinerja, dan administrasi ketenagakerjaan di area tambang. Peran ini memastikan bahwa semua kebijakan dan prosedur SDM sesuai dengan peraturan pemerintah dan mendukung produktivitas serta keselamatan di tempat kerja. Tanggungjawab: Bertanggung jawab penuh atas kegiatan yang ada di departemen HRD Mengkoordinasikan proses rekrutmen dan seleksi untuk memenuhi kebutuhan tenaga kerja. Menyusun dan mengelola database kandidat serta bekerjasama dengan tim operasional untuk menyesuaikan kualifikasi karyawan dengan kebutuhan pekerjaan. Mengawasi administrasi terkait kehadiran, lembur, cuti, dan perhitungan gaji. Bertanggungjawab untuk memastikan semua data data Karyawan tercatat dengan lengkap dan update. Melaksanakan dan megkoordinasi pengelolaan kedisipilinan karyawan. Menjaga kepatuhan terhadap regulasi ketenagakerjaan dan melaporkan masalah atau pelanggaran yang terjadi di lokasi kerja. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Manajemen SDM, Hukum, Psikologi, atau bidang terkait. Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang HR, lebih diutamakan yang memiliki pengalaman di sektor pertambangan. Pengetahuan mengenai peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia dan praktik hubungan industrial. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Memiliki sertifikasi di bidang K3 atau HR akan menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami dan dapat melakukan proses Recruitment, UU Ketenagakerjaan, BPJS dan Payroll Terbiasa melakukan coaching dan konseling Domisili di Balikpapan/Samarinda (Mess tidak tersedia)

Ringkasan Kerja:

HR Supervisor bertanggungjawab untuk mengelola berbagai fungsi sumber daya manusia, termasuk rekrutmen, pengembangan karyawan, manajemen kinerja, dan administrasi ketenagakerjaan di area tambang. Peran ini memastikan bahwa semua kebijakan dan prosedur SDM sesuai dengan peraturan pemerintah dan mendukung produktivitas serta keselamatan di tempat kerja.


Tanggungjawab:

  • Bertanggung jawab penuh atas kegiatan yang ada di departemen HRD

  • Mengkoordinasikan proses rekrutmen dan seleksi untuk memenuhi kebutuhan tenaga kerja.

  • Menyusun dan mengelola database kandidat serta bekerjasama dengan tim operasional untuk menyesuaikan kualifikasi karyawan dengan kebutuhan pekerjaan.

  • Mengawasi administrasi terkait kehadiran, lembur, cuti, dan perhitungan gaji.

  • Bertanggungjawab untuk memastikan semua data data Karyawan tercatat dengan lengkap dan update.

  • Melaksanakan dan megkoordinasi pengelolaan kedisipilinan karyawan.

  • Menjaga kepatuhan terhadap regulasi ketenagakerjaan dan melaporkan masalah atau pelanggaran yang terjadi di lokasi kerja.


Kualifikasi:

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Manajemen SDM, Hukum, Psikologi, atau bidang terkait.

  • Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang HR, lebih diutamakan yang memiliki pengalaman di sektor pertambangan.

  • Pengetahuan mengenai peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia dan praktik hubungan industrial.

  • Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.

  • Memiliki sertifikasi di bidang K3 atau HR akan menjadi nilai tambah.

  • Memahami dan dapat melakukan proses Recruitment, UU Ketenagakerjaan, BPJS dan Payroll

  • Terbiasa melakukan coaching dan konseling

  • Domisili di Balikpapan/Samarinda (Mess tidak tersedia)

jobs.description: Toddler Teacher Apple Tree Pre-School – PIK 2 Apple Tree Pre-School is looking for a caring, enthusiastic, and dedicated Toddler Teacher to join our team. The ideal candidate will enjoy working with children and be passionate about creating a safe, happy, and engaging environment where toddlers can learn, explore, and grow. We are an established preschool with more than 20 years of experience in early childhood education, with locations across Indonesia . We are committed to providing a nurturing learning environment that supports children's development and helps them build confidence, independence, and positive social skills. Placement: PIK 2, Tangerang Key Responsibilities Plan and deliver age-appropriate, play-based lessons and activities for toddlers. Create a warm, nurturing, inclusive, and safe classroom environment. Support toddlers' social, emotional, language, cognitive, and physical development. Encourage positive behaviour and guide children using appropriate classroom management strategies. Observe and monitor children's progress and provide appropriate support based on their individual needs. Communicate regularly and professionally with parents regarding children's progress, needs, and achievements. Work collaboratively with Teacher Assistants, teachers, and school staff. Maintain a clean, organized, and engaging classroom environment. Follow school policies and health and safety procedures. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Early Childhood Education, Preschool Education, Education, or a related field. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Previous teaching experience, preferably with toddlers or preschool-aged children. Patient, caring, energetic, creative, and responsible. Able to work well under pressure and manage classroom routines effectively. Confident in singing and familiar with children's songs and activities. Good communication and interpersonal skills. A team player and proficient in Microsoft Office Suite. Able to build positive relationships with children, parents, and colleagues. How to Apply Please submit your Curriculum Vitae (CV), highest educational certificate, and reference letter(s) to: ••••@gmail.com

How to Apply

jobs.title: cook
jobs.description: About the role Cook bertanggung jawab untuk menyiapkan, memasak, dan menyajikan makanan sesuai standar resep, kualitas, dan presentasi perusahaan. Posisi ini juga memastikan kebersihan area dapur, menjaga kualitas bahan baku, serta mendukung kelancaran operasional kitchen setiap hari. Key responsibilities Menyiapkan bahan makanan (food preparation) sebelum operasional dimulai. Memasak dan menyajikan makanan sesuai resep, standar kualitas, dan waktu penyajian yang telah ditetapkan. Memastikan setiap hidangan memiliki rasa, porsi, dan tampilan yang konsisten. Menjaga kebersihan area dapur, peralatan memasak, dan area penyimpanan sesuai standar higiene dan sanitasi. Melakukan pengecekan kualitas dan kesegaran bahan baku sebelum digunakan. Menyimpan bahan makanan sesuai standar FIFO (First In, First Out) dan prosedur penyimpanan. Mengontrol penggunaan bahan baku untuk meminimalkan pemborosan. Berkoordinasi dengan Service Crew untuk memastikan pesanan pelanggan disajikan dengan cepat dan akurat. Melaporkan kebutuhan bahan baku kepada atasan. Mematuhi seluruh Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP), kebersihan, dan keselamatan kerja di dapur. About you Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan jurusan Tata Boga atau Perhotelan. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Cook di restoran, café, bakery, atau industri Food & Beverage menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami teknik dasar memasak dan food preparation. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai standar kebersihan, sanitasi, dan keamanan pangan. Disiplin, jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur. Benefits Gaji kompetitif. Service charge (sesuai kebijakan perusahaan). Kesempatan pengembangan karier. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, bersih, dan suportif.

jobs.title: Server
jobs.description: Your Role in this Journey: Greet guests warmly and professionally upon arrival. Present menus and provide detailed information about food and beverage items. Take accurate food and drink orders and input them into the POS system. Serve food and beverages promptly while ensuring correct presentation. Always mention the name of the menu item when serving. Ensure tables are properly set, clean, and organized before and after service. Check guest satisfaction during service and handle complaints politely and efficiently. Clear used plates, glasses, and cutlery in a courteous and timely manner. Coordinate with the kitchen and bar team for smooth service operations. Maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards in all service areas. Follow all standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety regulations. Assist in upselling food, beverages, and promotions to guests. Maintain a professional appearance and positive attitude at all times. Who We’re Excited to Meet: Required Skills: Minimum high school diploma or equivalent. Previous experience as a server in a restaurant, bar, hotel, or rooftop venue is preferred. Good communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus). Friendly, polite, and service-oriented personality. Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Strong teamwork and coordination skills. Good knowledge of food, beverages, and basic service standards. Physically fit and able to stand for long working hours. Willing to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. Neat appearance and good personal hygiene. Preferred Qualification: Previous experience in hospitality, restaurants, cafés, bars, beach clubs, or hotels is an advantage. Strong passion for customer service and creating exceptional guest experiences. Good communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus. Positive attitude, professional appearance, and excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Strong teamwork, adaptability, and willingness to learn. Basic knowledge of food and beverage service, cocktails, coffee, or wine is preferred (depending on the position). Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and evening operations. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and attention to detail. Experience using POS systems and basic computer skills is an advantage. Food Safety & Hygiene certification is preferred. Candidates with barista, bartender, WSET, or other hospitality certifications will have an advantage (where applicable). Ability to handle guest complaints professionally and maintain high service standards. Demonstrates initiative, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Recruitment Details: ㆍ Application > Aptitude Test > 1st Interview > 2nd Interview > Compensation Negotiation > Final Onboarding Your Team At Canggu Sunset Club, we are more than just a Food & Beverage team we are passionate hospitality professionals dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences for every guest. Located in the heart of BWork Bali, Canggu Sunset Club offers a unique destination where guests can enjoy handcrafted beverages, delicious cuisine, breathtaking sunsets, and exceptional service in a relaxed and vibrant atmosphere. Our success is built on teamwork, professionalism, and a shared commitment to excellence. Every team member, from service staff and bartenders to kitchen and support teams, plays an essential role in ensuring that every guest receives warm hospitality, consistent quality, and memorable experiences. We are committed to: Delivering exceptional guest service with genuine care and professionalism. Maintaining the highest standards of food safety, hygiene, and operational excellence. Working together with integrity, respect, and accountability. Continuously learning, improving, and embracing innovation. Supporting one another to achieve both individual and team success. Creating a positive, welcoming, and energetic environment for both guests and colleagues. At Canggu Sunset Club, we believe that hospitality is about more than serving food and drinks it is about building connections, creating lasting memories, and making every guest feel welcome. Every smile, every cocktail, every dish, and every interaction reflects our dedication to excellence. Company Introduction Daewoong Bio Indonesia (DBI) is part of Korea’s Daewoong Group, expanding its global healthcare vision into hospitality in Bali. Building on the success of BWork , Bali’s No.1 coworking space, DBI is growing into coliving, wellness hubs, villas, and resorts including BLive, BFriends, BNesta, Munduk Wellness Resort, and AlamKulKul . Led by experts from Korea’s 5-star hotel and premium spa industries, we create hospitality experiences that connect work, wellness, and community , while contributing to Bali’s economy and global reputation as a wellness destination. Our Commitment at Daewoong: Top-Tier Rewards: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives. Autonomy & Growth: A workplace that trusts you to lead, learn, and grow. Meaningful Work: Contribute to a triple win — employee growth, customer satisfaction, and societal advancement. Expert Training: Direct learning from Korean hospitality and wellness leaders. Global Opportunities: From Korea trips to overseas placements, your career can go international. Our Culture At Daewoong, we believe healthcare is more than medicine; it’s about creating better lives. Guided by our WIN-WIN-WIN philosophy, we grow together with our people, customers, and society. We value autonomy, encouraging our team to work in their own best way, choosing where, when, and how they feel most focused. Growth is our priority: we set bold goals, learn continuously, and embrace feedback. Here, work isn’t just a job; it’s a chance to do something meaningful and impactful. Why Daewoong? Daewoong is a global healthcare leader founded in 1945, with operations in 100+ countries, 8 overseas branches, 5 R&D centers, and 4,500+ employees worldwide. In Indonesia, we employ over 360 professionals across Jakarta, Bali, Bekasi, and Surabaya. We’ve been recognized as: Best Workplace in Asia (2023) Best Workplace in Korea (2022) Outstanding Foreign Investment Company – Indonesian Government (2022) Women-Friendly Culture & Diversity Management Award (2022) Global Pharmaceutical R&D Innovation Award (2021) Best Innovation in Biotechnology – Metro TV (2025) Here, your talent is trusted, your growth is accelerated, and your impact is global. Meet Our Inspiring People: Trust + Autonomy = Growth | My Journey to GM in 3 Years https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4r4CdnswBlY From Analyst to GM in 3 Years Here’s How I Did It https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wPBWRvSGpGI The Trust That Let Me Work My Way And Grow Faster https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CNaknZH-pno A Company That Rewards You for What You Actually Do https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fw1c9ASOKIk

  • Positive attitude, professional appearance, and excellent interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • Strong teamwork, adaptability, and willingness to learn.

  • Basic knowledge of food and beverage service, cocktails, coffee, or wine is preferred (depending on the position).

  • Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and evening operations.

  • Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and attention to detail.

  • Experience using POS systems and basic computer skills is an advantage.

  • Food Safety & Hygiene certification is preferred.

  • Candidates with barista, bartender, WSET, or other hospitality certifications will have an advantage (where applicable).

  • Ability to handle guest complaints professionally and maintain high service standards.

  • Demonstrates initiative, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement.


Recruitment Details:

ㆍ Application > Aptitude Test > 1st Interview > 2nd Interview > Compensation Negotiation > Final Onboarding


Your Team

At Canggu Sunset Club, we are more than just a Food & Beverage team we are passionate hospitality professionals dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences for every guest.

Located in the heart of BWork Bali, Canggu Sunset Club offers a unique destination where guests can enjoy handcrafted beverages, delicious cuisine, breathtaking sunsets, and exceptional service in a relaxed and vibrant atmosphere.

Our success is built on teamwork, professionalism, and a shared commitment to excellence. Every team member, from service staff and bartenders to kitchen and support teams, plays an essential role in ensuring that every guest receives warm hospitality, consistent quality, and memorable experiences.

We are committed to:

  • Delivering exceptional guest service with genuine care and professionalism.

  • Maintaining the highest standards of food safety, hygiene, and operational excellence.

  • Working together with integrity, respect, and accountability.

  • Continuously learning, improving, and embracing innovation.

  • Supporting one another to achieve both individual and team success.

  • Creating a positive, welcoming, and energetic environment for both guests and colleagues.

At Canggu Sunset Club, we believe that hospitality is about more than serving food and drinks it is about building connections, creating lasting memories, and making every guest feel welcome.

Every smile, every cocktail, every dish, and every interaction reflects our dedication to excellence.


Company Introduction

Daewoong Bio Indonesia (DBI) is part of Korea’s Daewoong Group, expanding its global healthcare vision into hospitality in Bali. Building on the success of BWork, Bali’s No.1 coworking space, DBI is growing into coliving, wellness hubs, villas, and resorts including BLive, BFriends, BNesta, Munduk Wellness Resort, and AlamKulKul.

Led by experts from Korea’s 5-star hotel and premium spa industries, we create hospitality experiences that connect work, wellness, and community, while contributing to Bali’s economy and global reputation as a wellness destination.


Our Commitment at Daewoong:

  1. Top-Tier Rewards: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

  2. Autonomy & Growth: A workplace that trusts you to lead, learn, and grow.

  3. Meaningful Work: Contribute to a triple win — employee growth, customer satisfaction, and societal advancement.

  4. Expert Training: Direct learning from Korean hospitality and wellness leaders.

  5. Global Opportunities: From Korea trips to overseas placements, your career can go international.


Our Culture

At Daewoong, we believe healthcare is more than medicine; it’s about creating better lives. Guided by our WIN-WIN-WIN philosophy, we grow together with our people, customers, and society. We value autonomy, encouraging our team to work in their own best way, choosing where, when, and how they feel most focused. Growth is our priority: we set bold goals, learn continuously, and embrace feedback. Here, work isn’t just a job; it’s a chance to do something meaningful and impactful.


Why Daewoong?

Daewoong is a global healthcare leader founded in 1945, with operations in 100+ countries, 8 overseas branches, 5 R&D centers, and 4,500+ employees worldwide. In Indonesia, we employ over 360 professionals across Jakarta, Bali, Bekasi, and Surabaya.

We’ve been recognized as:

  • Best Workplace in Asia (2023)

  • Best Workplace in Korea (2022)

  • Outstanding Foreign Investment Company – Indonesian Government (2022)

  • Women-Friendly Culture & Diversity Management Award (2022)

  • Global Pharmaceutical R&D Innovation Award (2021)

  • Best Innovation in Biotechnology – Metro TV (2025)

Here, your talent is trusted, your growth is accelerated, and your impact is global.

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description: Uraian Tugas : Mengelola proses packing, penimbangan, pelabelan, dan scanning barang hingga menjadi stok siap kirim. Memastikan akurasi dan ketersediaan stok melalui monitoring serta stock opname secara berkala. Mengatur proses loading dan transportasi pengiriman ke Gudang ABU dengan menerapkan sistem FIFO (First In, First Out) . Mengontrol ketersediaan consumable packing untuk memastikan operasional warehouse berjalan lancar. Memastikan tim memahami dan menjalankan Work Instruction (WI) dan SOP sesuai standar perusahaan. Melakukan review dan improvement proses kerja untuk menjaga akurasi, efisiensi, dan ketertiban operasional warehouse. Wewenang : Memberikan rekomendasi terhadap proses di gudang yang lebih efektif & efisien. Requirements : Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Supervisor Warehouse , dengan pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di Cold Storage . Memahami Warehouse Management, Product & Material Handling Equipment . Memiliki kemampuan dalam pengelolaan stok, alur barang, dan operasional pergudangan . Mampu memimpin tim dan memastikan operasional berjalan sesuai SOP dan target perusahaan . Placement : Pasuruan (RPA)

jobs.title: Admin Penjualan
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. Sumber Inspirasi Prima mencari seorang Admin Penjualan yang terorganisir, detail-oriented, dan responsif untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Gamping, DI Yogyakarta. Sebagai Admin Penjualan, Anda akan menjadi tulang punggung operasional tim penjualan kami, memastikan semua proses administratif berjalan lancar dan mendukung kesuksesan penjualan perusahaan. Posisi ini adalah peran waktu penuh yang menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkontribusi langsung pada pertumbuhan bisnis kami sambil mengembangkan keterampilan administratif yang komprehensif. Kandidat ideal memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent, keterampilan organisasi yang luar biasa, dan komitmen terhadap keunggulan layanan. Tanggung Jawab Mengelola dan memperbarui database penjualan, termasuk data pelanggan, quotation, dan pesanan dengan akurat dan tepat waktu. Memproses pesanan penjualan dan memastikan semua dokumentasi lengkap sebelum dikirimkan ke departemen lain. Menyiapkan dan mengirimkan quotation, invoice, dan dokumen penjualan lainnya kepada pelanggan. Mengelola jadwal dan appointment tim penjualan, mengatur meeting, dan koordinasi dengan departemen terkait. Memberikan dukungan administratif kepada tim penjualan dalam hal follow-up pelanggan, tracking pesanan, dan resolusi masalah. Mempersiapkan laporan penjualan harian, mingguan, dan bulanan dengan format yang terstruktur dan akurat. Mengelola komunikasi email dan telepon dengan profesional dan responsif. Mengarsipkan dan mengorganisir dokumen penjualan sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan. Mendukung kegiatan promosi penjualan dan event pemasaran sesuai kebutuhan. Persyaratan Lulusan SMA/SMK atau diploma (D3) dalam bidang Administrasi, Perkantoran, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Admin Penjualan atau posisi administratif serupa di industri yang relevan. Kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang excellent dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan diutamakan Bahasa Inggris dasar. Menguasai Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) dengan profisiensi tinggi, khususnya Excel untuk data entry dan laporan. Familiar dengan sistem CRM atau software penjualan akan menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki keterampilan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang sangat baik dalam menangani multi-tasking. Teliti, akurat dalam bekerja dengan standar tinggi dalam penanganan data dan dokumentasi. Sikap profesional, responsif, dan kemampuan problem-solving yang baik. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman dalam industri penjualan produk atau jasa. Manfaat Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan keterampilan. Tunjangan kesehatan dan asuransi jaminan sosial sesuai peraturan perusahaan. Cuti tahunan dan cuti bersama sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Lingkungan kerja yang professional, mendukung, dan kolaboratif. Peluang pengembangan karir dan pelatihan profesional untuk meningkatkan kompetensi. Program bonus kinerja berdasarkan pencapaian target. Lokasi kerja strategis dengan akses transportasi yang mudah di Gamping, Yogyakarta. Tentang Kami PT. Sumber Inspirasi Prima adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi bisnis terbaik dan layanan berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami. Dengan visi untuk menjadi mitra terpercaya dalam pertumbuhan bisnis klien, kami terus berinovasi dan mengembangkan produk serta layanan yang relevan dengan kebutuhan pasar. Budaya perusahaan kami menekankan integritas, kerja keras, dan kolaborasi tim. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki peran penting dalam kesuksesan perusahaan, dan kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, mendukung pengembangan profesional setiap karyawan, dan menghargai kontribusi mereka terhadap pertumbuhan bersama. Cara Melamar Jika Anda tertarik dengan posisi ini dan memenuhi kriteria yang kami cari, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Silakan siapkan CV, surat lamaran, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya. Kami menunggu kehadiran Anda untuk menjadi bagian dari tim PT. Sumber Inspirasi Prima!

jobs.title: Designer Grafis dan Illustrator
jobs.description: Deskripsi pekerjaan Syarat – Syarat : Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Desain Komunikasi Visual (DKV), Seni Rupa, atau bidang terkait . Memiliki kemampuan menggambar ilustrasi manual maupun digital . Menguasai software desain seperti Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, atau software ilustrasi lainnya . Kreatif, inovatif, dan memiliki sense visual yang baik . Mampu membuat ilustrasi yang sesuai dengan materi buku (edukatif dan komunikatif) . Memahami dasar layout, komposisi warna, dan tipografi . Teliti, detail, dan mampu bekerja sesuai deadline produksi buku . Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim (editor, penulis, dan tim produksi). Memiliki portofolio ilustrasi (lebih diutamakan ilustrasi pendidikan / buku anak / buku pelajaran). Tugas Tanggung Jawab (Job Description) : Membuat design cover buku dan ilustrasi gambar untuk kebutuhan buku (buku pelajaran, buku anak, atau buku edukasi). Menerjemahkan konsep materi dari editor atau penulis menjadi ilustrasi yang mudah dipahami pembaca. Membuat gambar pendukung materi seperti diagram, karakter, infografik, dan visual pembelajaran. Mengolah ilustrasi agar sesuai dengan layout dan desain buku . Melakukan revisi ilustrasi sesuai arahan editor atau tim produksi . Menyesuaikan ilustrasi dengan standar visual dan gaya desain penerbit . Bekerja sama dengan editor, penulis, dan tim layout dalam proses produksi buku. Membantu pembuatan ilustrasi untuk kebutuhan promosi buku (poster, katalog, media sosial). Menjaga konsistensi kualitas visual ilustrasi pada setiap proyek buku.
